ENV-CITY-BOX-EXPANDED-ATOMIC-1.change: check_city_expand_reply (mb_hostentity.h) now validates every raw word first (state, name, count, finite classification of all six words, zero tail), then the numeric minimum <= maximum of each of the three EXPANDED axes, BEFORE the exchange copies one word to the caller's box and before ct_msgs.c writes the mirror. The order is taken from the raw words (sign-magnitude to one signed int32 key): no floating value is loaded or compared, the two zeros are the same number, no word is changed. ENV-CITY-BOX-BOOT-PROTOCOL-1.CURRENT_par.change: request_join_problem(city_expand) now also requires the CURRENT city placement and the served child's list to be the same city BEFORE scan_question counts the question eligible (box_eligible) or sends the host's state withdrawal. The driver tracks acknowledged LINKs: a LINK of a sector placement to a key that names a list (a list name that is no building) records that the placement CONTINUES that list (alias[placement] = list name), as the host's own rejoin does; scan.city.anchor(key) maps a placement key to its list name (itself otherwise). The join compares anchor(city) with anchor(list of the child); unrelated sector and list keys are never compared raw. A refused LINK is never tracked and nothing is inferred from callback order. A roster boot clears the aliases with the lists.
ENV-CITY-BOX-BOOT-PROTOCOL-1.CURRENT_par.legitimate_paths_kept: an empty-city relink (no list; the first building is listed under the new placement) and a relink with buildings listed (the new placement links to the first key the list was named by) are eligible and credited (positive controls; a raw key comparison would fail the relink case).
